conditions: Business page expressly distinguishes business accounts for companies reselling models or running products and says resale is allowed under business terms; applications are reviewed by a person, and account access is not automatic.

Exclude all consumer apmix plans: current Terms prohibit reselling access, wrapping apmix as one's own API, and sharing a key across unrelated users; the Business page says plan resale is not allowed.
Obtain and review the full Business agreement/terms, approved tier, model scope, customer key rules, use restrictions, data/security, liability and service commitments before eligibility.

For each request, record apmix as gateway and the actual upstream serving provider separately. Consumer Terms say requests are forwarded to the provider that serves the selected model and provider usage policies apply.

Only currently approved model IDs may be offered for resale; the Business page says apmix chooses and can change the resale model list. Publisher labels/catalog entries alone do not establish serving route, model license rights, or entitlement.

Current Business list prices and weighted-token multipliers are dynamic, tier-dependent, and not Vrooli customer prices; record approved quote, availability and human price/trust decisions separately.
